caption: A vibrant bowl of ramen sits on a polished wooden table. The rich flavors are visible in the frothy broth, tender chashu, and glossy egg.

segments_info.text: Browned chashu pork, tender and slightly crispy on the edges
Glossy boiled egg, perfectly rounded and slightly golden at the edges
The miso broth is frothy and rich, with a deep amber hue and slight texture from bubbles
